description: The line plot illustrates the loss values over iterations for six different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," spans from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, representing the number of training iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1, indicating the model's loss value. All six models start with a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0. The Vanilla model (purple line) shows a rapid initial decrease in loss, followed by a plateau around 2.7. The StrmLLM (n=64) model (blue line) follows a similar trend, decreasing quickly and stabilizing around 2.8. The SepLLM (n=64) model (orange line) also decreases rapidly and stabilizes around 2.8. The SepLLM (n=64, H) model (green line) shows a similar pattern, with a rapid decrease and stabilization around 2.8. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model (red line) follows a similar trend, with a rapid decrease and stabilization around 2.8. The SepLLM (n=128) model (dark blue line) shows a rapid decrease in loss, followed by a plateau around 2.8. Overall, all models converge to a similar loss value, with the SepLLM models showing slightly better performance in terms of loss reduction.
